p14-how-we-check: Every badge tells you who said so, and when.
Their front desk confirmed it in the last 14 days.
At least 3 patients said it worked in the last 30 days, and more said yes than no.
Only the NHIA or insurer list says so. Call first.
3 or more patients were turned away since the hospital last confirmed, and more than were served. This beats any list.
Strongest answer first, then today's status, then distance. Without a card: today's status, then distance. Places with no services listed come after, by distance; pharmacies aren't shown.
Under 24 hours: shown as is. 1 to 3 days: "may have changed". Older: greyed out until the hospital checks in.
Counts cover the last 7 days, 30 days or 12 months, and say which. Reports we hold back or reject are kept, never counted.
Sorted by status and distance only. Your card never hides a hospital.
Hospitals can't pay to change a badge. Paid partners get tools and reports, never a better rating.
